Figure 1. Steps involved in the production of semi-synthetic artemisinin. The initial amorphadiene-producing strain Y337 was improved by the expression of
several genes including those encoding Artemisia annua cytochrome P450 enzyme amorphadiene oxidase (CYP71AV1), its cognate reductase (CPR1), cytochrome
b5, artemisinic aldehyde dehydrogenase (ALDH1), and artemisinic alcohol dehydrogenase (ADH1) to obtain strain Y1284 which produced 25 g/l of artemisinic acid.
The artemisinin acid was extracted and chemically transformed into artemisinin.
